measure.name: contam_coupled_infiltration
measure.description: Replaces the model infiltration with infiltration and interzone airflow computed by a CONTAM multizone model coupled to EnergyPlus every timestep, or surveys the model for the CONTAM infiltration campaign.
measure.modeler_description: Calls osm2contam (python -m osm2contam comstock-prepare) on the model as built. coupled: removes every SpaceInfiltration object, adds one zero-flow SpaceInfiltrationDesignFlowRate per thermal zone and one zero-flow ZoneMixing per directed zone pair, named as osm2contam's coupling.json states, sets the timestep, and adds a PythonPluginInstance whose plugin drives ContamX through contamxpy and actuates those objects. attributes: computes the zone attributes and the building strata axes and registers them, changing nothing. The Python interpreter is OSM2CONTAM_PYTHON if set, else python (Windows) or python3.

argument.name: mode
argument.description: off: do nothing. attributes: survey the model, change nothing. coupled: couple CONTAM to the EnergyPlus run.

argument.name: timesteps_per_hour
argument.description: EnergyPlus timestep and CONTAM synchronization interval in coupled mode. 60 is a 60 s step, CONTAM's minimum. Ignored in attributes mode.

argument.name: assumptions
argument.description: osm2contam assumptions YAML. Blank for the bundled default.

argument.name: capacitance_multiplier
argument.description: ZoneCapacitanceMultiplier:ResearchSpecial temperature multiplier, for a coupling that rings. 0 leaves it unset.

argument.name: on_translation_failure
argument.description: fail: the datapoint fails. skip: leave the model unchanged and mark the measure not applicable. default: fail in coupled mode, where an uncoupled run would pass for a coupled one, skip otherwise.
